name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, with selectable trees, flowers, grass and water, Random and Mixed modes, and a refined Sprout Tower. Complete Pallet, Viridian City, Route 1, Viridian Forest, Gen 1 caves, New Bark, Cherrygrove, Violet, Azalea, Mahogany, Cianwood, Olivine, Ecruteak, Blackthorn, Lake of Rage, Mt. Silver Outside and Gen 2 Pallet backgrounds. Johto Routes 29,30,31,33,35,36,37,42,43,44,45,46 are complete. Goldenrod has a clean native Johto Game Corner. Bell Tower retains the supplied wider proportions and transparent decorative side tiles. Other maps remain in progress.
